subject: Renewal documents: exhibit consolidation & order form clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstice.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@solstice.com
Date: Sat, 30 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — initial redlines attached

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Solstice is looking to execute a 12-month renewal with a capacity increase from 120M tokens/mo to 210M tokens/mo, plus an add-on for private VPC ingestion.

Attached: Solstice_MSA_redline_20280930.docx (tracked changes) and Solstice_OrderForm_v3.xlsx (proposed quantities & billing). Our GC has suggested a handful of edits to the MSA (Sections 4.2, 7.1 — liability cap language; & Exhibit B — usage tiers). We flagged a requested term shift to 12 months with a 30-day notice window for termination.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can accept a 12-month firm term (we prefer annual but are flexible on start date)
- How billing proration will work for mid-cycle capacity increases
- Whether audit logs and SSO will be covered by the Private deployment add-on

We'd like to get counters back this week if possible — Solstice procurement is aiming to sign by 10/10.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
VP, Procurement | Solstice Health
Elena.Rossi@solstice.com

Attachments: Solstice_MSA_redline_20280930.docx (track changes), Solstice_OrderForm_v3.xlsx (quantity matrix)

From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstice.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial redlines attached

Hi Elena — thanks for the docs and the clear timeline. We're excited to keep Solstice on Redwood and support the VPC add-on. Quick plan:

1) I'll triage the order-form quantities with Marissa and confirm pricing/proration rules.
2) Looping in David (legal) to review the MSA redlines and comment on cap/liability and the 12-month term language.
3) We'll produce a consolidated redline (MSA + Exhibit mapping) and an updated order form for signature.

A couple of quick answers:
- We can support a 12-month firm term; we just need to align on start date and billing cycle for the uplift.
- Proration: for mid-billing-cycle quantity increases we typically bill pro rata for the remainder of the cycle and apply monthly at the new quantity thereafter — I'll confirm exact calendar math with billing.
- Audit logs & SSO: we support audit log retention and SSO in Private deployments; David will confirm any language your GC wants for SLAs/auditability.

Target: consolidated redline + clean order form by EOD Wed (10/03). If that timeline will be a blocker for you, let me know.

Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstice.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial redlines attached

Alex / Marissa / Elena — I reviewed Solstice's MSA redline. High-level: most asks are standard but there are three items I'd like to call out with proposed language. I've attached a PDF with inline comments (MSA_redlines_dk_20281002.pdf).

1) Liability cap (Section 7.1): Solstice asks to change to "greater of $5M or 12 months' fees." We're open to a compromise: "greater of $3M or 12 months' fees" with explicit carveouts for gross negligence and willful misconduct. Please confirm if your GC can accept that.

2) Term & termination: The 12-month firm term is acceptable. We need precise start date and a provision for proration on mid-cycle capacity increases. Suggested clause: "Charges for capacity increases shall be pro-rated based on the number of days remaining in the then-current billing period and billed on the next invoice."

3) Exhibit B (usage tiers): I'll normalize the tiers to match Redwood's billing cadence and call out the private VPC add-on as a separate line item with its own SLAs (audit logs retention: 365 days; SSO: SAML 2.0 supported). If Solstice wants longer retention we can add it as an addendum for an extra fee.

Small note: please remove the unilateral audit right language — we prefer scoped audits with notice and mutually agreed auditors.

Next steps: I'll prepare a consolidated MSA with tracked changes and a clean order form. If Elena's team prefers, I can also prepare a redline with strike/insert for each clause to make the back-and-forth easier.

David

--
David Kim
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Attachments: MSA_redlines_dk_20281002.pdf (inline comments + redline)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solstice.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@solstice.com
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — initial redlines attached

David / Alex — appreciate the quick review. A few responses:

- Liability cap: Solstice's GC is willing to accept Redwood's counter of "greater of $3M or 12 months' fees" provided we retain a narrowly scoped data-breach carveout limited to direct remediation costs. We can add that language if Redwood agrees.

- Proration language looks fine; please include a concrete example in the order form (e.g., mid-cycle increase on 10/15 for a 30-day month = pro rata for 16 days).

- Exhibit B: we'll accept the private VPC as a separate line item with the stated SLAs. Can you make sure the order form shows the VPC unit price and the one-time onboarding fee?

Attached: updated_orderform_with_quantities.xlsx (I edited the monthly quantity ramp).

If you can send the consolidated redline + clean order form, procurement will review and (barring surprises) route for signature the following week.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: updated_orderform_with_quantities.xlsx
